svg.text: ClickHouse 25.8 · DDL generated by src/tank/clickhouse_market.py from src/tank/market_schema.py · 8 tables · exchange market series and prints (HLD §7.1) · ClickHouse has no foreign keys: relations are logical, by instrument_id / token_id
exact decimal stored as text (String, up to 100 digits)
hides the paired <col>_prec and <col>_prec_reason Nullable(String) columns
logical reference to a PostgreSQL table (cross-database, unenforced)
Types and codecs (identical across the series tables)
Columns outside ORDER BY are Nullable(…); arrays are not. The first column is
storage_key String (except mkt.trades: own explicit schema, no skip indexes).
ORDER BY key = record identity: when parts merge, the row
with the highest _version survives; reads always use FINAL.
